title: refactor(ci): consolidate node workflows, split lint/test, optimize cache parallelism
author: Elena Martinez
description: Motivation: our repo has accumulated dozens of near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows for Node builds, lint, test, and release automation. This PR consolidates shared steps into a single reusable workflows/common.yml, splits lint and test into focused matrices to improve parallelism and developer feedback time, and tightens cache keys to reduce unnecessary cache misses. Summary of changes: - Add .github/workflows/common.yml with reusable steps for checkout, setup-node, install-cache, and upload-cache. - Replace multiple node-setup jobs across packages with uses: ./.github/workflows/common.yml and explicit matrices where needed. - Split lint and test pipelines so lint runs as a fast pre-commit check and tests run in a separate matrix with job-level caching. - Improve actions/cache keys by including lockfile hash and package.json workspace fingerprint to reduce cross-package invalidation. - Add heuristics to skip slow integration matrix when only package.json/docs are touched. - Consolidate release automation workflows to a single workflow with a release:trigger input to reduce duplication. Checklist: [x] consolidate shared steps [x] split lint/test matrices [x] validate cache key behavior in CI [x] update CONTRIBUTING.md CI section [x] smoke test release workflow on staging Environment and rollout plan: stepwise merge to main, monitor CI times over 48 hours, revert by rolling back the workflow file if regressions observed. Related links: Linear ENG-2021, ENG-1999. Note: this is intentionally conservative refactor—no runtime code changes are included.
